mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months indicates an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 4.8% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of months with UNRATE > 4.8%, or the Rank IC is negative over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, weakening corporate revenue prospects and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when either HOUST or RSAFS does not decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 signals manufacturing sector slowdown that reduces corporate capacity utilization and near-term earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 55% of months with INDPRO < 110.0, or the Rank IC for INDPRO is negative over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in retail sales (RSAFS) over the prior 3 months reflects strong consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with rising RSAFS, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals accelerating price pressures that trigger Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of months with CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or the Rank IC is negative over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate above 4.5% and non-farm payrolls below 135,000 thousand signal severe labor market deterioration that reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when UNRATE ≤ 4.5% or PAYEMS ≥ 135000, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent industrial production below 110.0 and unemployment above 4.5% signal dual stress on supply and labor markets that indicates imminent recession, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with INDPRO < 110.0 and UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
